meta.caption:
Your seller's broker shuts down the day after you buy. Did you lose your money? 😨

Absolutely not. 🛡️ The clearing corporation steps in the middle of every trade. It becomes the seller to you and the buyer to the seller. That's called NOVATION.

Backed by margins + the Settlement Guarantee Fund.
You don't trust the stranger. You trust the system.
